beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Spring entrance: pop-in, watch it settle — the bounce is the whole statement. Overshoot spring: the mark slams in and corrects; high bounce, judge the rebound. Draw-on stroke: the outline traces first, fill floods. Per-path stagger: the H body arrives, the diagonal follows. The H shape makes stagger visible.

Your turn. Paste this: run the H logo through spring entrance and draw-on stroke, then tell me which one reads as confident and which reads as patient. Confidence arrives all at once. Patience shows its work.
H logo, in motion. Part one. Liam, in for Bear.
